comment: Installs a Trp-C5 to Arg-Cγ cross-link at all three WPR motifs of the precursor peptide WprA. Requires the chaperone WprC

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 1 removed auxEnzyme genpept (was MDX7991759.1): retrieval issues from NCBI GenPept.

auxiliaryEnzymes.name: WprC
auxiliaryEnzymes.description: Chaperone protein required for cross-link formation

reactions.description: C–C bond formation between Trp19-C5 and Arg21-Cγ of the precursor peptide WprA
unmodified WprA precursor; cross-link localised to the WPR motif by MS/MS, structure solved by NMR on the tryptic fragment
C–C bond formation between Trp37-C5 and Arg39-Cγ of the precursor peptide WprA
second of three cross-links; the three are installed independently of one another
C–C bond formation between Trp55-C5 and Arg57-Cγ of the precursor peptide WprA
fully cross-linked WprA; still a precursor, downstream proteolytic processing follows
